CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-mutation-anchor, at head a55a0f47ecf5e805dc86bf8b9eb157755271efa8. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch a55a0f47ecf5e805dc86bf8b9eb157755271efa8 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-mutation-anchor, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-mutation-anchor <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-mutation-anchor; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Body-only repair on origin/handoff/r10-mutation-anchor a55a0f47e (code unchanged; merge origin/main first). The opener was refused: ci predict pr-contract, CARRY UNROUTED item 66c85c55. Rewrite the section so it is either exactly "none" with the stage sentence removed from it (move that sentence to Friction or Uncertainties), or one `Carry:` line routing the item to a live roster group (cite the roster sha) or `dismissed: <reason>`. Re-take the whole body, re-run tools/pr/prepr.sh to a pass, push handoff-body/r10-mutation-anchor via body_push.sh. Group R10-MUTATION-ANCHOR, issue 2493.
